highlights: Number of Batteries    1 Lithium Polymer batteries required. (included)

Rechargeable Smart Battery and Long-Lasting: Say goodbye to disposable batteries. Just 20 minutes of charging powers your wallet tracker card for up to a full year. Designed for long-term use, it delivers reliable performance without the hassle or cost of battery replacements, making it a smarter and more sustainable choice.

Keep Track of Your Valuables with Wallet Tracker: Left something outside? If it is at the airport, shopping mall, or cafe, simply open the map in the Find My app to view its location and get directions
Loud 100dB Alert for Easy Location: Misplaced your item nearby? Tap "Play Sound" in the Apple Find My app to trigger a loud 100 dB alert, easy to hear even when hidden

Instant Lost Item Notifications on Your Phone: When your Bluetooth Air Tracker Tags moves out of range, the Find My app sends an alert with its last known location. Activate Lost Mode with your contact info for quick recovery via nearby Apple devices

Quick and Easy Setup: Press and hold the function button for 2–3 seconds on wallet tracker card, then follow the Find My app prompts to pair. Supports iPhone/iPad (iOS 14.5+) and Mac (macOS 11+). Keep Bluetooth on and select Other Supported Items when pairing
